每次请求的数据来自 Ollama 日志，仅读取计时和上下文用量（请求结束时的占用: Per-request data comes from the Ollama log; only timing and context usage (how much was used when the request finished) are read.

数据来自 Claude Code 的会话登记和会话记录，仅读取标题、目录、状态、: Data comes from Claude Code's session registry and session logs; only titles, folders, status, models and token usage are read, not conversation content. Context is the tokens sent to the model in the latest request. Limits (Beta) come from the plan usage recorded by the Claude desktop app, using only records for the same organization Claude Code is signed in to. They are not precise: the desktop app records once at startup, and every 15 minutes only if its tray usage panel was opened in the last 24 hours, so the numbers are often hours old and the reset time is unknown.
桌面版的一个 codex 进程服务所有会话，因此列出最近有活动的会话。额度为最近: One codex process in the desktop app serves all sessions, so recently active sessions are listed. Limits are the values the server returned with the latest request. Only status and usage are read from the session logs, not conversation content. For ChatGPT tasks set to run on this computer, the conversation and model live on ChatGPT's servers; this computer only has the codex process that runs commands for it. It starts a few tool processes for each turn and closes them when done, so only the start time of the conversation and whether a turn is in progress are visible. Title, folder, model, usage and how the turn ended are not, and no completion notice is shown.
数据来自 DeepSeek Harness 自行生成的会话汇总（~/.dsh/s: Data comes from the session summaries DeepSeek Harness computes itself (~/.dsh/storages); only titles, folders, status, models and token usage are read. Subtasks are not listed separately. The balance comes from the ledger kept by the dsh-whale-widget plugin (~/.dsh/.dshw-usage.json); no API key is read and nothing goes online. Without the plugin there is no balance. "Spent today" uses Beijing time days, like the plugin. Set the balance alert in the DeepSeek Harness section of the settings page.
数据来自 Grok Build 的会话目录，仅读取标题、模型、回合和权限事件、上: Data comes from Grok Build's session folders; only titles, models, turn and permission events, context and token usage are read, not conversation content. Token usage updates at the end of each turn.
数据来自 OpenCode 的会话数据库（opencode.db），仅读取标题、: Data comes from OpenCode's session database (opencode.db); only titles, folders, models, when turns start and end, and token usage are read, not conversation content. While a tool call waits for your confirmation or answer, the database has no record of it, so the session shows as working. Child sessions are not listed separately.
数据来自 OpenClaw 各 agent 的会话数据库，仅读取标题、聊天渠道、: Data comes from the session database of each OpenClaw agent; only titles, chat channels, models, message roles and stop reasons, context and token usage are read, not conversation content. While a tool call waits for your confirmation, the database has no record of it, so the session shows as working. Child sessions are not listed separately.
数据来自 Antigravity 的对话库（~/.gemini/antigrav: Data comes from Antigravity's conversation databases (~/.gemini/antigravity); only titles, folders, run status, the status and time of each step, model names, context and token usage are read, not conversation content. Token usage updates after each model reply. Subagent conversations are not listed separately. Limits (Beta) are read once a minute from its background program language_server through an undocumented local interface (using the token from its command line, local connections only) and may stop working after an update. Models in the same group share one limit.
数据来自 Cursor 数据目录中的状态库（state.vscdb），仅读取对话: Data comes from the state database in Cursor's data folder (state.vscdb). Only conversation titles, workspaces, status, whether something is waiting for you, models and context are read, never the conversation content. Cursor does not save token usage there, so there is no input, output or output speed; it also does not record whether a turn failed or you pressed Stop, so both show as Interrupted. Subagent conversations and archived conversations are not listed.
Beta：读取自 Claude 桌面版记录的套餐用量数据，仅供参考。桌面版仅在启: Beta: read from the plan usage recorded by the Claude desktop app, for reference only. The desktop app records once at startup, and every 15 minutes if its tray usage panel was opened in the last 24 hours, so the data can be hours old and has no reset time. The 5-hour limit is hidden once the record is more than 5 hours old.
Beta：每分钟从 Antigravity 后台程序（language_serv: Beta: read once a minute from Antigravity's background program (language_server) through its local interface; it may stop working if an update changes that interface. Limits are shared by model group.
余额数据由 DeepSeek Harness 的“余额小鲸鱼”插件（dsh-wh: The balance is recorded in a local ledger by the dsh-whale-widget plugin for DeepSeek Harness (it checks about every 25 seconds while the DeepSeek Harness window is open). The alert threshold can be changed on the settings page.
